contract: DESIGN.md: compact international entry; only PE/CSE available; country-scoped content; preserve legal text and existing functionality; production/main unchanged.

accessibility.evidence: 328 E2E and 30 unit tests pass. Axe checks include ES/EN first views, seven pages and 404, menu and progress states. Keyboard, focus, label-in-name, non-text contrast, reduced motion, forced colors, 320px reflow and 200% root text resizing were checked. This is tested scope, not full WCAG certification.

responsive.evidence: Eight rendered ES/EN first-screen geometry records verify title, description, service and primary action fit all four viewports at normal text size. Ninety-two screenshots exist; independent visual review found no remaining blocking clipping. Desktop grid and enlarged-text wrapping were corrected.

loading.reason: Country packages and translations are bundled locally; no asynchronous service or delayed-content state was introduced. Initial network loading is still required before offline use.

empty.evidence: MX/CO/ES and unknown countries return no procedures without falling back to PE; UI explains unavailable verified guides and offers an explicit return to Peru. Checklist zero state retains eleven accessible controls.

error.evidence: Invalid guide routes recover; corrupt or blocked storage remains usable with its notice; the 404 screen keeps navigation and a return action. All regression cases ran.

partial.evidence: Checklist two-item state and guide position persist without implying an approved application. Details open by keyboard and all source paragraphs remain reachable in ES/EN.

success.evidence: Guide reaches its final step; eleven checked items and reset behave correctly. Print preserves complete country-scoped steps, eleven items, five sources and local certainty notes. No official submission is performed.

permission.reason: No account, citizen document, geolocation or sensitive information is requested. Country is a manual content selection rather than a device-location permission.

renderedEvidence.observation: Purpose, description, PE/CSE identity and Comenzar fit above the fold with readable type; the large doorway has become a compact service cue.
English copy and service remain visible before scrolling; complete Home is 1616px rather than the previous 3685px in the Spanish full-page comparison.
Balanced entry and service columns keep the first screen compact; columns can stack when root text grows.
Two columns occupy the intended width; an accidental empty third track was removed and typography retains hierarchy.
